description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities &amp; Energy Trading practice is growing and we are hiring Consultants and Senior Consultants (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich. The level offered will reflect your experience, expertise and demonstrated impact.</span></span></h2> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities, and large energy consumers, supporting them to navigate increasingly complex markets, manage flexibility in their portfolio and deliver large-scale transformation programmes. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, and technology delivery.</p> <p>This is your opportunity to combine deep industry exposure with hands-on client delivery, working directly with leading traders, utilities and renewable energy businesses as they transform their trading operations, integrate flexibility assets and adopt new technologies.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); Clean Fuels, Power, Metals, or Oil. <br>We recognise that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds, so you do not need experience across all of these areas to apply.</p> <ul> <li>Commodity and energy trading, risk management, market analysis, commercial operations or trading support functions.</li> <li>Trading transformation initiatives, helping organisations improve processes, systems and ways of working across the front-to-back trading lifecycle.</li> <li>Data, analytics and emerging AI-enabled use cases within trading environments.</li> <li>ETRM/CTRM platforms and supporting technologies, including business analysis, requirements gathering, testing, implementation or continuous improvement activities.</li> <li>Market, credit, operational or regulatory risk topics, with an interest in helping trading organisations strengthen governance, controls and performance.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on your experience and interests, you may also bring skills in one or more of the following areas:</p> <ul> <li>Business analysis, problem solving and transformation delivery experience.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including data analysis and visualisation.</li> <li>Experience working with business and technology stakeholders to deliver practical solutions.</li> <li>An interest in data, analytics, AI and digital technologies within commodity and energy trading.</li> <li>Senior Consultants are expected to demonstrate ownership of workstreams, adapt quickly to complex situations, and thrive in client-facing environments.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in German and English is required for this role.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); raw.title: Senior AI-Native Fullstack Engineer (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Job description

We are building modern, customer-facing software for the temp-staffing industry, integrating capabilities from multiple ERP systems and countries into reliable applications, workflows, services, and reusable platform components.

We are looking for a product-minded senior fullstack engineer who can turn ambiguous business requirements and complex existing systems into production-grade backend services, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and intuitive user interfaces.

TypeScript is central to our technology landscape. Experience with .NET and C# is strongly valued, while engineers with a background in strongly typed languages such as Java are also welcome. Comfort working across different stacks and languages is essential.

AI and LLM tooling are central to how we work. You should use AI-native workflows to explore faster, build in parallel, validate assumptions, and ship high-quality production solutions. You should care about correctness and maintainability, understand integration and business edge cases, choose simple and robust solutions, and own outcomes from exploration to production.


Your tasks

  • Fullstack Product Engineering: Build customer-facing applications, backend services, APIs, internal tools, admin interfaces, automation, job runners, and configurable workflows
  • Backend & Domain Logic: Design maintainable services, APIs, business logic, asynchronous processes, validation rules, and reusable components
  • Frontend Engineering: Build intuitive and maintainable user interfaces using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks
  • Integrations: Connect applications with ERP systems, internal platforms, external APIs, databases, queues, files, and third-party services
  • Cloud & Production Ownership: Deploy and operate reliable cloud solutions, preferably AWS, owning monitoring, alerts, failure handling, security, performance, cost, and operational reliability


Your profile

  • Hands-on with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-based workflows; GitHub Copilot-style autocomplete alone is not enough
  • Familiar with worktrees, subagents, MCP, structured prompts, harness engineering, parallelization, and validating AI-generated code and analysis to production quality
  • Strong fullstack/backend experience, ideally with .NET and TypeScript
  • Able to build production-grade services, APIs, scripts, tools, automation, and clean interfaces; comfortable with version control, review, debugging, testing, and existing systems
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, domain modeling, integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and maintainable software boundaries
  • Comfortable with SQL, relational databases, schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, and application-level data access
  • Hands-on with AWS or similar cloud environments, including storage, databases, queues, containers, serverless/scheduled processing, SDKs, and APIs
  • Understands deployment, secrets, networking, permissions, runtime configuration, scalability, performance, cost, and operational trade-offs
You may be a good fit if you are driven to improve how software is built, use AI and agent-based workflows to move faster, experiment with better approaches, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable production solutions. You should enjoy working across the stack, taking ownership beyond predefined tickets, improving existing systems, and rigorously validating AI-generated output rather than accepting it at face value. This role is less suitable for someone who prefers narrow responsibilities, fixed processes, or working within a single technical area without contributing to broader product and engineering outcomes.


Your benefits

  • Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
  • Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership
  • Individual development opportunities, structured onboarding, and interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Flexible working models including hybrid work, home office, and mobile working
  • A modern tech environment and agile ways of working
  • Additional benefits such as pension plans, health offers, and employee discounts

Your Profile

  • 5+ years building software close to customers: forward deployed or deployment-style engineering, technical program leadership in a product company, or an engineering-heavy path through top-tier consulting at Manager level or above.

  • You write code and you want to keep writing it. Python and SQL at working level, comfortable with data pipelines and integration architecture.

  • 1+ years leading engineers, or you have built something from zero and had people follow you into it.

  • Native or C1 German, fluent English.

You are not inheriting a team, you are defining a function that most companies in enterprise AI are only starting to understand they need. Do this well for 12 to 18 months and you own one of Tacto's core technical organisations, with a direct line into the product roadmap and a hand in how leading global industrials adopts AI.

  • This is not a people-management role with technical decoration. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong job.

Why Tacto

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

  • New Business: You own complex, multi-stakeholder deals in Tacto's largest accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

  • Deal Leadership: You run executive demos, workshops, business cases, and negotiations, and navigate procurement and legal processes through to close

  • Account & Segment Strategy: You build account strategies for the largest industrial groups and map how these organizations buy across sites and buying centers, landing in one business unit and expanding across divisions, plants, and modules

  • Customer Added Value: You act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, building business cases that clearly quantify ROI, savings, and strategic impact

  • Sharpen the Motion: You turn what works in your deals into best practices the enterprise team can build on, and feed insight back to Product and Leadership

  • Become AI Native: You use AI to research accounts, prepare executive conversations, and run complex pipelines with maximum efficiency

 

Your Profile

Now you may wonder what experiences and skills you need for this role. We believe that problem-solving, creativity, and drive are more important than tools that can be picked up. However, the following references will give a guideline of what experiences we think might be helpful.

  • A proven closing track record in complex enterprise B2B software sales: multi-stakeholder, high-value deals, long sales cycles (6+ months)

  • You've sold into large, complex organizations and know what good looks like; you bring a proven approach and adapt it to our conditions rather than needing one handed to you

  • You lead deals with senior and C-level stakeholders and keep long, multi-threaded cycles moving to signature

  • You sell value over features and translate technical depth into business impact

  • You bring strong sales fundamentals and apply common methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, SPIN, SPICED) pragmatically

  • Low ego, high integrity, team-first: you're here for the mission and the craft, not just the commission, and you make the people around you better

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in German and English

  • Curiosity for procurement, supply chain, or manufacturing is a plus

Who Thrives Here

You're a closer, and you take pride in owning complex, high-stakes deals from first meeting to signature. You've sold into large, layered organizations before, so you bring a point of view on how to win and adapt it to how Tacto works. But the way you win matters as much as the winning. You're low-ego and genuinely team-first, the kind of person colleagues want in the room, who shares what works and lifts the people around them. A serious closer who's also a great person to work with.

Why Tacto

  • A standout sales organization built for the long term

    • ~90% of AEs hit their quota, with top performers reaching up to 400%

    • Incentives that reward over-performance: 150% uncapped kicker

    • No compromises on the talent bar: a lean, high-density team of A-players who push each other, with zero elbow culture. We hire the best, incentivize them right, and promote from within.

  • Top-tier support so you can focus on closing

    • CVMs recruited exclusively from top-tier consultancies (BCG, Inverto, AT Kearney, Oliver Wyman) own onboarding and tee up your upsells, a Proof of Value team builds your business case in 48 hours, plus dedicated Value Engineers, Solution Engineers, Sales Ops, and a BDR machine that delivers the majority of your qualified pipeline

  • A truly AI-native sales organization

    • Access to all the leading AI tools plus a stack of custom agents that handle the work that used to eat your week, from meeting prep and demo follow-ups to value cases, call coaching, and instant battlecards, so you spend your time selling, not preparing to sell

    • We invest to keep it that way: dedicated 'AI captains' across every team, with a group focused on Sales and Go-to-Market, building new tooling and running enablement so new knowledge spreads fast

  • Backed to win big

    • Sequoia- and Index-funded, with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda, from Sam Altman to Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem

    • Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events

    • e.g. Sales-focused Events with CRO of DeepL, CRO of Dash0 or ex Head of RevOps at Forto

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

raw.description:
About Navflex

At Navflex, we're pioneering the future of logistics automation through cutting-edge AI and

robotics. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) are transforming the way goods are loaded

and unloaded, enabling plug-and-play solutions that streamline operations and enhance

efficiency across the global supply chain for some of the world’s most demanding warehouse

Environments. Our international, cross‑disciplinary team in the EU and USA pairs robust mechatronics with cutting‑edge navigation and perception to deliver safe, reliable autonomy in real‑world warehouses and yards. Join us in shaping the future of intelligent logistics.

 

What makes us different

  • We bring hardware and AI into production, not just prototypes

  • We work directly with real warehouse operations and customer environments

  • We build systems that must be safe, reliable, and economically viable

 

What you can expect at the Munich Team

You will join a highly skilled, hands-on engineering team working at the intersection of robotics, product development, and real-world deployment, with direct impact on systems used by global customers.

 

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on robotics systems that are already used in real-world environments

  • A role where you can actively shape systems and see the impact of your work

  • A collaborative, international team with diverse backgrounds and perspectives

  • Plenty of room for personal and professional growth as we continue to scale

  • Challenging work alongside experienced engineers who are passionate about what they do

  • A culture that values ownership, learning, and continuous improvement

  • Competitive compensation

The Role

You will own system-level validation of Navflex’s autonomous forklift AMR—by continuously testing new software on real vehicles, stress-testing the system against the operational domain, and building automated test infrastructure that closes the gap between lab results and field performance.

This is not a “ticket-only QA” role. You will reproduce issues, analyze logs and data, and drive investigations far enough to pinpoint the most likely subsystem (perception, localization, planning, controls, HW interface, fleet services) and the fastest path to root cause and fix.

 

Success Measures - Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Regressions are caught early and software is released with evidence-based readiness.

  • Test coverage expands across the operational design domain (ODD), including edge cases and failure modes.

  • Field issues become reproducible in lab/replay/HIL with clear fault isolation and actionable engineering feedback.

  • A scalable automation framework exists (SIL/HIL + log replay + on-robot tests) with dashboards and automated reporting.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own scenario-based validation across the operational domain

    • Define and maintain an Operational Design Domain (ODD) and scenario library that reflects real warehouse and trailer-loading workflows (normal operation, edge cases, abuse cases).

    • Translate requirements and known risks into testable acceptance criteria, pass/fail metrics, and release gates.

    • Design and execute functional, regression, performance, reliability, and safety validation plans at the system level.

    • Plan long-duration stability/endurance campaigns and track reliability trends over time.

  • Continuously test software on real vehicles (lab + field)

    • Own day-to-day test execution on a vehicle fleet: smoke tests, nightly/weekly regressions, and targeted experiments for new features and bug fixes.

    • Run structured test sessions that intentionally challenge autonomy behavior in a safe, controlled way (tight spaces, occlusions, pallet variability, trailer geometry, degraded sensors, etc.).

    • Support pilots and customer transitions; ensure evidence-based sign-off for rollout and ramp.

  • Debug, reproduce, and isolate issues using logs and data

    • Reproduce failures using on-robot tests, log replay, simulation, and HIL as appropriate.

    • Analyze logs/traces and recorded datasets (e.g., ROS bag files, telemetry, event logs) to identify failure signatures and likely root causes.

    • Create high-signal bug reports with minimal repro steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and supporting evidence (plots, log snippets, metrics).

    • Partner with engineers to drive issues to closure and prevent regressions.

  • Build automated test infrastructure (SIL/HIL + reporting)

    • Develop automated test scripts that run against simulation and log replay, and extend them to execute on physical robots where feasible.

    • Design and implement Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) capabilities to validate critical interfaces and autonomy behavior without always needing a full vehicle-in-the-loop setup.

    • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD (per-PR, nightly, and release-candidate runs).

    • Build tooling to compare expected vs. actual vehicle behavior from logged data; establish dashboards for coverage, pass rates, and reliability trends.

    • Automate test reporting and release readiness summaries for engineering, product, and operations stakeholders.

  • Improve test process and raise the quality bar

    • Own test request intake: guide developers to the right validation method (unit/integration/system/HIL/field) and prioritize by risk and impact.

    • Continuously refine workflows to improve coverage, safety, and confidence in every release.

    • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in testing, documentation, and safe operations around robotic hardware.

What You’ll Bring

  • Systems-level mindset and comfort reasoning about a complex robotics stack and failure modes.

  • Strong debugging discipline and hands-on comfort with physical robots in lab and field environments.

  • Clear communication and an evidence-based approach to feedback and decision-making.

  • Ownership mentality: you take responsibility for quality outcomes, not just test execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 5+ years in system testing, validation, integration testing, or quality engineering for complex electromechanical products (robotics, autonomous systems, vehicles, industrial automation, or similar).

  • Python proficiency for test automation and data analysis; ability to read and navigate C++ codebases strongly preferred.

  • Strong Linux proficiency and experience with Git-based workflows.

  • Experience designing structured test plans and executing them with clear pass/fail criteria and documentation.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.

Preferred, But Not Required

  • Experience testing AMRs/AGVs, autonomous forklifts, or other mobile robots in production environments.

  • Experience with ROS or ROS 2 (introspection tooling, bagging/replay, launch/test utilities).

  • Experience with simulation or digital twin environments (e.g., Gazebo, Isaac Sim, Webots, Unity) and sim-to-real validation practices.

  • Experience with HIL/SIL test setups, fault injection, and long-duration stability testing.

  • Experience validating API contracts and distributed systems that interface with robot fleets (fleet manager, telemetry pipeline, integrations).

  • Familiarity with safety standards relevant to driverless industrial trucks (e.g., ISO 3691-4) and safe testing practices around heavy equipment.

  • Experience with test management/bug tracking tools (e.g., ClickUp, TestRail) and building metrics dashboards.

  • German language proficiency.

Work Environment & Safety

This role involves hands-on work around industrial robotic equipment. You must be able to follow safe operating procedures, work in warehouse environments (noise, dust, temperature variation), and support occasional after-hours or weekend test windows when needed for deployments. Navflex is an equal opportunity employer.

Strong working knowledge of relevant safety standards and methods; ideally ISO 3691-4 for AGVs/AMRs, and/or ISO 13849-1 / IEC 62061. Practical experience with safety sensors and safety circuits (e-stops, safety laser scanners, safety encoders, safety I/O, interlocks). Confident Python programming skills and ability to read/debug production Python code in a multi-component robotics system. Comfortable working hands-on with hardware in a lab/warehouse environment and iterating quickly based on test results. Fluent English (German is a strong plus). TÜV Functional Safety certification (or similar) and/or experience working directly with notified bodies and third-party test labs. Tools & Environment SICK Safety Designer (must-have); experience with Flexi Soft ecosystems is highly relevant. Safety-rated sensors and components (safety laser scanners, safety encoders, safety I/O, safety relays/contactors). Being a Product Designer at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

You’ll be taking on a senior, high-ownership role in product design at Aios Medical. We have multiple roles in the team across our clinical software and customer facing mobile app.

You’ll be stepping into a product that has grown fast and needs stronger design leadership, judgment, and structure.

Some of this work is visible and polished. Some of it is messy and internal. You’ll own projects end-to-end. That means taking loosely defined problems, talking to the right people, understanding workflows and constraints, and shipping solutions you can stand behind. We’re looking for someone who can run with a problem independently and be trusted to get it over the line.

You might be working with engineers on a customer app flow, untangling a complex internal workflow that’s slowing teams down, reviewing CX tickets to understand where users are breaking, or defending a design decision.

Craft: You care about clarity and usability more than surface-level polish. You can work within fixed requirements, technical limitations, and existing systems, and still make meaningful improvements.

Clear thinking & communication: You can clearly explain what problem you were solving, why certain decisions were made, and what tradeoffs were involved. You’re comfortable defending your work and navigating discussions with strong opinions.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

Our product is used daily by non-technical procurement professionals who need AI to feel natural, trustworthy, and genuinely useful — not like a black box bolted onto a legacy workflow. We're hiring a Senior or Staff Product Designer to join a small, high-craft design team embedded closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts. This is a pivotal role: you'll define how agentic AI capabilities surface in the product — from the moment an agent starts working, through to how findings and recommendations are presented and acted upon. Great design here doesn't just improve usability; it directly determines whether powerful AI features get adopted and whether customers realise real cost savings. What You'll Do Define interaction patterns for agentic AI capabilities — covering status states ("the agent is working"), result surfaces ("here's what it found"), and human-in-the-loop collaboration moments. Design workflows that position AI and human judgment as collaborators, not competitors, with a clear focus on trust and transparency. Produce short-horizon vision work (3–6 month horizon) as runnable prototypes and tangible artefacts that align and guide the broader team. Raise overall product craft and coherence as engineering velocity and feature output scale. Work directly in code for last-mile polish — check out PRs and fine-tune interactions before features ship. Partner with product managers, engineers, and procurement domain experts to translate complex, data-heavy workflows into clear, usable experiences. What We're Looking For Required: Senior-level product design experience with a strong portfolio of shipped work — ideally in B2B SaaS, complex workflows, or data-heavy products. A "block-shaped" designer: solid across visual design, interaction design, product thinking, and prototyping in code — not a single-specialty generalist. raw.description:
About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

The Role

We're hiring a Tax Compliance Manager to take ownership of tax compliance and reporting across our growing global entity structure. This role is based in our New York City office.

You'll work closely with external advisors, finance colleagues, and cross-functional teams to ensure our compliance obligations are met to a high standard across all jurisdictions, while supporting the wider tax team on new market launches, product rollouts, and planning projects as the business scales.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone looking to own tax compliance in a fast-scaling fintech — gaining broad exposure across a range of countries and entity types, working directly with senior stakeholders, and building a deep understanding of how tax supports a business as it grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Global Tax Compliance: Manage end-to-end tax filings across all group entities, coordinating with external advisors to ensure accurate, timely returns in every jurisdiction.

  • Manage Outsourced Providers: Own the relationship with third-party compliance providers — setting scopes, reviewing deliverables, and holding quality standards across regions.

  • Lead Tax Reporting: Support the preparation of tax provisions, deferred tax calculations, and disclosures for statutory accounts and group reporting (IFRS and/or US GAAP).

  • Support New Market Launches: Ensure tax compliance requirements are embedded from day one whenever the business enters a new market or launches a new product.

  • Contribute to Tax Projects: Work alongside the wider tax team on transfer pricing documentation, group restructurings, and assessments of legislative change.

  • Build Better Processes: Develop and improve internal tax controls, reporting, and processes as the function matures and the entity structure grows.

  • Stay Ahead of Tax Developments: Monitor changes in key jurisdictions and feed these into the team's wider planning.

  • Liaise with Auditors & Tax Authorities: Act as a key point of contact for external auditors, tax authorities, and advisors on compliance queries, audits, and ad-hoc filings.

  • Monitor Effective Tax Rates: Prepare and maintain current and deferred tax reconciliations, tracking effective tax rates across the group.

What We're Looking For

  • Qualified CPA, or equivalent professional qualification.

  • At least 5 years of relevant tax experience, whether in practice (Big 4 or mid-tier) or a combination of practice and in-house.

  • Strong grounding in corporate tax compliance and reporting, with exposure to international or multi-jurisdictional work.

  • Comfortable managing external advisors and reviewing outsourced deliverables to a high standard.

  • Solid understanding of tax accounting and provisioning under US GAAP and/or IFRS — both is a plus; one is required.

  • Experience with transfer pricing compliance or documentation is a plus, but not essential.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or a high-growth startup environment is a plus.

Who You Are

  • Ownership mindset — you take responsibility, follow through, and move things forward without heavy oversight.

  • Communication — you explain tax matters clearly to non-specialists and know how to land a complex point simply.

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you make practical recommendations even when the answer isn't clear-cut.

  • Curiosity — you have a genuine interest in how tax supports a fast-growing, international business.

  • Collaborative — you work well across teams and build relationships easily.

1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

You'll help shape the Virtual Assembly Line (VAL) team, which builds and scales our growth and operations systems: MarTech, CRM, Payment, Fulfillment and Installation, so we can scale globally with maximum efficiency and quality.

  • Own technical direction across VAL's growth and operations engineering domain, keeping architecture aligned with product direction, and hold the team accountable for consistent execution of those decisions

  • Set the technical bar for the teams, stepping into the hardest problems yourself rather than just directing others

  • Translate business and product requirements into technical solutions that scale as we digitize the installation branches further

  • Architect our systems and APIs so AI agents operate as first-class users with machine-readable contracts

  • Drive VAL's shift to agentic engineering, reshaping how the team works so agents execute safely while humans stay accountable

  • Mentor and challenge engineers within VAL to accelerate their growth

  • Build a high-performing engineering culture within the VAL team

  • Embed security and reliability as direct customer value

Technologies you will work with include:

  • AI-assisted development with Cursor / Claude and agentic coding workflows

  • Languages: TypeScript (React, Nest.js, Next.js, VueJS), Ruby on Rails, Flutter

  • Cloud & Infra: Google Cloud Platform, GKE (Kubernetes), Cloud Run, Terraform/IaC, Vercel, Datadog

  • Data & BI: PostgreSQL, BigQuery, SQLMesh, Looker

  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro


Dein Profil

  • Extensive hands-on experience in software development with multiple general-purpose programming languages for a minimum of 10 years

  • A proven track record of architecting scalable and secure systems, demonstrating a strong commitment to quality

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing APIs that enable seamless integration between systems, as well as for non-human/automated consumers like AI agents

  • An agile and result-oriented mindset, with a strong emphasis on collaboration and teamwork

  • Experience communicating with stakeholders in business terms and understanding the technical implications of their requirements

  • Experience driving technical alignment within a team in fast-paced environments, including making and following through on critical technical decisions

  • Track record of leading a team through a major workflow or tooling shift, with the judgment to know where automation (including AI agents) can run safely and where human sign-off stays mandatory

  • Proven ability to own features end-to-end, from rough problem statement to shipped, maintained product, working closely with product managers and business stakeholders across the company

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with proficiency in German considered a plus


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time
  • Individualised opportunities for professional development
  • Reporting directly to the CTO

title: Research Engineer
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>We are seeking highly motivated and skilled <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Research Engineers</span> who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.</li> <li>Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.</li> <li>Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.</li> <li>Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.</li> <li>Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.</li> <li>Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.</li> <li>Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.</li> <li>Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.</li> <li>Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.</li> <li>Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.</li> <li>Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.</li> <li>Previous experience at a top-tier finance <em>or</em> technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.</li> <li>Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have <em>real</em> hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.</li> <li>Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)</li> <li>Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. While there is no hard language requirement for RE roles, proficiency in one of these languages will be assessed during the interview process.</li> <li>Kindness and empathy is a real requirement. No “smart jerks” at HRT.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>HRT ships every day. description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.</p> <div><strong>About SIMBA Voice Agents by Speechify</strong></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>SIMBA lets companies deploy natural, human-sounding AI voice agents in 71+ languages with sub-second latency. We don't just hand customers a product and wish them luck — every customer gets a Forward Deployed Engineer who builds their agents, joins their Slack, and iterates with them weekly. We're building the future of voice AI, and we're looking for someone who can sell that vision and help bring it to life<br><br><strong>About the Role</strong></div> <div> <p>As an Account Executive / Go-to-Market, you're equal parts dealmaker and builder. You'll own the full sales cycle for new customers — from first call to close — while also getting hands-on during technical evaluations, demos, and early deployment. You understand that selling voice AI isn't just about pitching features; it's about showing prospects exactly how SIMBA fits into their world and making that first integration feel effortless.</p> <p>This is a rare role for someone who can command a boardroom and open a terminal.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close for mid-market and enterprise accounts</li> <li>Run technically deep discovery calls to understand customer use cases, tech stack, and integration requirements</li> <li>Build and demo custom voice agent prototypes during the sales process to accelerate buy-in</li> <li>Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure a seamless handoff from sale to onboarding</li> <li>Develop GTM playbooks, messaging, and outbound strategies to help SIMBA break into new verticals</li> <li>Represent customer needs internally, influencing product roadmap and packaging decisions</li> <li>Maintain a clean pipeline in CRM and accurately forecast revenue</li> </ul> </div> <div><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></div> <ul> <li>3–6 years of experience in a sales, account executive, or GTM role at a technical B2B company</li> <li>Track record of closing deals with both technical buyers (CTOs, engineers) and business stakeholders</li> <li><em>Comfortable getting hands-on with APIs and no-code/low-code tools to build compelling demos</em></li> <li>Strong understanding of the AI/ML or voice technology landscape — you follow this space closely</li> <li>Exceptional communicator who can simplify complex technical concepts without losing their depth</li> <li>Highly self-directed with strong pipeline discipline and a bias toward action</li> </ul> <div><strong>Nice to Have</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience selling AI, voice, or conversational technology</li> <li><em>Familiarity with telephony infrastructure, contact centers, or customer experience platforms</em></li> <li>Prior experience in a forward deployment or solutions engineering capacity</li> <li>Multilingual or experience selling into international markets</li> </ul> <div><strong>Why Speechify SIMBA</strong></div> <ul> <li>Sell a product that genuinely impresses prospects — sub-second latency and 71+ languages speaks for itself</li> <li>High ownership role with direct input on GTM strategy and positioning</li> <li>Work alongside a team that stays embedded with customers, so you're never selling something that doesn't deliver</li> <li>Competitive base + commission, equity, and benefits</li> <li>Fast-moving startup environment where your wins have outsized impact</li> </ul> <p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Refer them!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re hiring an Automations Engineer to build the systems that run our influencer and creator marketing program at scale. As the program grows, nearly every step—discovery, onboarding, contracts, content tracking, reporting, and payments—can be automated. You’ll own that automation layer end-to-end: designing, building, and maintaining the workflows and integrations that let a lean team manage thousands of creators without manual busywork. The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder who is equally comfortable in no-code and low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n) and writing custom code (Python or JavaScript) against APIs. You think in systems, care about reliability and clean data, and get satisfaction from replacing a manual process with a workflow that just runs. This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with the influencer/creator team, marketing ops, finance, legal, and data/BI. What you will do Creator discovery: build automations that query social platforms and databases for profiles matching brand keywords and follower thresholds CRM data sync: automatically push new influencer profiles and contact details into the team’s database Onboarding: send automated welcome packets, brand guidelines, and brief templates when a creator joins Contract generation: auto-fill creator names, dates, and payout rates into legal templates from form data, and route for e-signature Content reminders: trigger automated Slack messages or emails to creators before posting deadlines Content tracking: use APIs to log when an influencer posts and capture live links automatically Data aggregation: pull views, likes, comments, and clicks from social APIs into a central dashboard Report generation: produce weekly and monthly performance spreadsheets without manual data entry ROI calculation: compute cost-per-engagement and conversion rates automatically for each campaign Invoice processing: route creator invoices to finance systems once content is verified as live Payment status alerts: send automated notifications to finance and creators when payments process Build and maintain the integrations and webhook triggers that connect social platforms, CRM, finance, Slack, and e-signature tools Own reliability: error handling, monitoring, secrets management, and audit trails so automations run cleanly and securely Validate and troubleshoot data (SQL) and document workflows so they stay maintainable as the program scales Requirements Hands-on experience building automations with no-code/low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar) Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python or JavaScript) for custom logic and API work Experience integrating APIs and building webhook-driven workflows across marketing, CRM, and finance systems SQL proficiency for data validation and troubleshooting Systems thinking with strong attention to reliability, error handling, and clean data Comfort with secrets management, authentication, and basic security and audit practices for automations Clear communicator who can partner with non-technical marketing, finance, and legal stakeholders You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up Bonus Experience with influencer/creator marketing platforms (CreatorIQ, GRIN, Upfluence, Aspire, or similar) Experience with social platform APIs (TikTok, Instagram/Meta, YouTube) Experience with e-signature (DocuSign) and payment/finance integrations (PayPal, Stripe, Bill.com , or similar) Familiarity with data warehouses and BI tools Experience using AI/LLMs to build or accelerate automations Location This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. About ElevenLabs

We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring an Automations Engineer to build the systems that run our influencer and creator marketing program at scale. As the program grows, nearly every step—discovery, onboarding, contracts, content tracking, reporting, and payments—can be automated. You’ll own that automation layer end-to-end: designing, building, and maintaining the workflows and integrations that let a lean team manage thousands of creators without manual busywork.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder who is equally comfortable in no-code and low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n) and writing custom code (Python or JavaScript) against APIs. You think in systems, care about reliability and clean data, and get satisfaction from replacing a manual process with a workflow that just runs. This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with the influencer/creator team, marketing ops, finance, legal, and data/BI.

What you will do

  • Creator discovery: build automations that query social platforms and databases for profiles matching brand keywords and follower thresholds

  • CRM data sync: automatically push new influencer profiles and contact details into the team’s database

  • Onboarding: send automated welcome packets, brand guidelines, and brief templates when a creator joins

  • Contract generation: auto-fill creator names, dates, and payout rates into legal templates from form data, and route for e-signature

  • Content reminders: trigger automated Slack messages or emails to creators before posting deadlines

  • Content tracking: use APIs to log when an influencer posts and capture live links automatically

  • Data aggregation: pull views, likes, comments, and clicks from social APIs into a central dashboard

  • Report generation: produce weekly and monthly performance spreadsheets without manual data entry

  • ROI calculation: compute cost-per-engagement and conversion rates automatically for each campaign

  • Invoice processing: route creator invoices to finance systems once content is verified as live

  • Payment status alerts: send automated notifications to finance and creators when payments process

  • Build and maintain the integrations and webhook triggers that connect social platforms, CRM, finance, Slack, and e-signature tools

  • Own reliability: error handling, monitoring, secrets management, and audit trails so automations run cleanly and securely

  • Validate and troubleshoot data (SQL) and document workflows so they stay maintainable as the program scales

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building automations with no-code/low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python or JavaScript) for custom logic and API work

  • Experience integrating APIs and building webhook-driven workflows across marketing, CRM, and finance systems

  • SQL proficiency for data validation and troubleshooting

  • Systems thinking with strong attention to reliability, error handling, and clean data

  • Comfort with secrets management, authentication, and basic security and audit practices for automations

  • Clear communicator who can partner with non-technical marketing, finance, and legal stakeholders

  • You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up

Bonus

  • Experience with influencer/creator marketing platforms (CreatorIQ, GRIN, Upfluence, Aspire, or similar)

  • Experience with social platform APIs (TikTok, Instagram/Meta, YouTube)

  • Experience with e-signature (DocuSign) and payment/finance integrations (PayPal, Stripe, Bill.com, or similar)

  • Familiarity with data warehouses and BI tools

  • Experience using AI/LLMs to build or accelerate automations

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

title: Doctors and Medical Experts required for AI research Projects (open/rolling applications)
description: We are looking for doctors to join our growing community of experts who are available to be matched on an on-going basis to new innovative AI projects with the world's leading AI labs and companies that are bringing to life AI in healthcare. Your medical expertise will shape the way AI understands and processes real-world clinical interactions, workflows, consultations including the delivery of care with software that directly impacts both healthcare professionals and patients. These projects are flexible, fully remote and ideal for clinicians who want to work on shaping the future of AI in healthcare alongside their existing professional or academic commitments. About Mentis AI At Mentis AI, we’re building the next generation of AI systems grounded in real-world clinical expertise. As a clinical expert, you’ll gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge AI model development, working side-by-side with senior AI researchers and clinicians to translate your medical knowledge into industry-ready clinical solutions to advance healthcare. How it works Once we have a new project, you will be automatically screened and matched to assess if you are a suitable fit. If shortlisted, we will then invite you to take a skills test (~10-30mins) and if required will also conduct an interview. We are looking to match you based on your skillset, expertise, grade and speciality to make sure it's the right fit for the project! If successful, you will be onboarded onto the platform and can start getting involved in a diverse range of tasks that vary from labelling clinical notes, summarising medical records, annotating images to reviewing and evaluating the performance of AI Models/LLMs. The rapid rise of AI in healthcare means there are so many new and exciting ways to train, review and improve the deployment of AI in healthcare, which you will directly have an impact upon. Key Responsibilities Data labeling and curation: Review clinical notes, audio, videos and other modalities, identifying relations and reasoning steps per guidelines. LLM and model evaluations: Run structured evals (human-in-the-loop) to assess accuracy, safety, clinical relevance and clinical reasoning of models. Prompting and prompt-engineering: Design, test, and iterate prompts to improve performance and reliability. Fine-tuning support: Create high-quality instructions/responses and explore edge-case datasets to enhance models. Feedback and error analysis: Identify critical/failure points, propose strategies to help mediate and document findings. Scoring/Rubrics frameworks: Develop and refine scoring rubrics for quality assurance (e.g., accuracy, clarity, safety, completeness, guideline adherence). Guideline refinement: Collaborate with researchers to improve annotation standards, acceptance criteria, and evaluation protocols. Essential Requirements Doctor based in the UK with an active GMC license. Native or near-native fluency in English (spoken and written). Good understanding of clinical terminology, tools and workflows. Excellent summarisation and written communication skills. Strong attention to detail and commitment to clinical accuracy. Comfortable working independently in an asynchronous environment. What We Offer Remote work Asynchronous and flexible scheduling, allowing you to balance work with clinical practice or studies. Competitive compensation based on experience. The opportunity to influence and enhance AI tools that serve healthcare professionals. Experience working at the intersection of medicine and AI, helping shape the future of healthcare. Opportunity to collaborate with clinicians and AI researchers to deepen your own clinical acumen and professional expertise in AI within healthcare. raw.title: Head of Sales | Fund Administration | VC & PE | Private Markets
raw.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets.

You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes

  • Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands

About you

  • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

  • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

  • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

  • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

  • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

  • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

  • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

  • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

  • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

  • You communicate excellently in English

Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

What success looks like

In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Founder’s Interview (60 min) – Role deep dive, sales leadership, and commercial scope

  3. Sales Leadership Case (60 min) – Coaching, pipeline discipline, and complex deal execution

  4. Final Round (3 x 45 min) – Meet our leadership team (Tech, Ops, CS).

  5. In-person Meet & Greet with team members.

  6. Reference checks

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

Deine Chance: Werde Teil eines Teams mit Herz und Know-how, das den Snack-Markt neu definiert. DEIN BEITRAG ZUR ERFOLGSGESCHICHTE Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Supply Chain Management bist Du ein wichtiger Teil unseres Teams und unterstützt uns tatkräftig bei der Auftragsabwicklung, Koordination von Transporten und Unterstützung bei Abrufen von Rohwaren aus unserem Lager. Mit Deiner strukturierten und eigenständigen Arbeitsweise trägst Du direkt zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens bei! Deine Aufgaben beinhalten: Du überwachst täglich unsere Aufträge in unseren ERP-Systemen (Xentral, everstox etc.) und stellst sicher, dass alle Lieferungen an Kunden, Lieferanten und Handel pünktlich versendet und zugestellt werden. ERP- und Fulfillment-Systeme schrecken dich nicht ab – idealerweise hast du mit Xentral, everstox oder ähnlichen Systemen gearbeitet. Du arbeitest strukturiert, detailorientiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick. Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und denkst lösungsorientiert. Du bist ein Teamplayer mit Hands-on-Mentalität und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenbereiche zu übernehmen. WAS WIR DIR ANBIETEN KÖNNEN Wir glauben daran, dass großartige Arbeit nur in einem Umfeld entsteht, in dem Du Dich wirklich wohl fühlst und Du selbst sein kannst. Deshalb haben wir eine Unternehmenskultur geschaffen, die auf Vertrauen, Gemeinschaft und echter Flexibilität basiert. Echte Gemeinschaft: Ein Team, das unsere Werte atmet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Studium & Job im Einklang: Maximale Flexibilität durch Remote-Work, Home-Office und eigenverantwortliche Zeiteinteilung. Team-Highlights: Echte Verbindung trotz Remote-Fokus – inklusive unserer legendären, einwöchigen buah-Workation. Impact & Mitgestaltung: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und die Chance, ab Tag 1 Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Moderne Ausstattung: Die neuesten digitalen Tools für reibungsloses Arbeiten. Deine Benefits: Monatliche Gutscheine oder Wellpass, ein großzügiges buah-Produktbudget sowie regelmäßige Überraschungen. Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!
